fib: ______ is the nominal interest rate that is compounded without limit, or continuously.
The continuous compound rate is the nominal interest rate that is compounded without limit, or continuously.
______ is an annuity whose payments begin on a fixed date and continue forever.
A perpetuity is an annuity whose payments begin on a fixed date and continue forever.
______ is a powerful mathematical computer program, designed to perform a wide variety of mathematical calculations and operations.
Maple is a powerful mathematical computer program, designed to perform a wide variety of mathematical calculations and operations.
______ is a high performance language for technical computing.
MATLAB is a high performance language for technical computing.
______ means the calculation of its no-arbitrage or risk-neutral price.
Pricing of an option means the calculation of its no-arbitrage or risk-neutral price.
______ is the total amount that a series of future payments is worth now.
The present value is the total amount that a series of future payments is worth now.
